overview: Before dinner you set four labels on a working sheet and wrote the problem under them: four men, each forsworn, each with a rhyme, and no way to bring them on without four scenes. You did not solve it. No messenger is on the leaf. The lines are foul paper.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the knot and did not untie it.

important_dates.meaning: Four men, and no way on
